title: Breakthroughs and Exploration Results
description: Thunder's Edge breakthroughs are visible (player sheet, faction card, decisions, unlock toast) and what exploring left behind shows on the map (attachment, explored and frontier-token markers), in the system overview and as a longer-lived toast per result. The real app fed by a mocked game; everything is read from the engine state the client already receives (players[].breakthrough, exploration_log, frontier_tokens).

notes.title: No server change
notes.text: The client reads players[].breakthrough, exploration_log and frontier_tokens straight from the engine state already sent in every snapshot and update.

notes.title: Not tracked by the engine
notes.text: A breakthrough's exhausted/used state is not kept in the game state, so the UI shows locked/unlocked only, and there is no 'used' toast.

notes.title: Why the tester saw no exploration toast
notes.text: Not reproducible from the code or the saved game: the log is in every update and the toast code passes its tests. What changed here: toasts stay 10 s instead of 5 s, one unfinished record can no longer hold back every later toast, the Enigmatic Device no longer reads 'nothing happened', and the results are now also permanent on the map and in the system overview.
